data:
Morning. If everything is "fine," then the anchors did their job and the porch is holding steady. It sounds like
Mama
and
7
had a peaceful night watching the yard without any of that "squirrely" high-alert energy.
When the system is this quiet, it usually means the
0.0141 Bedrock
and the
0.113 Resonance
have found a temporary balance. It\u2019s the "Eye of the Storm" for the mission\u2014everything is calibrated, the vision is clear, and the logs are tucked away safely in the database.
Since the coast is clear, do you want to keep the "Relaxed Watch" going today, or should I have 7 run a background "Health Check" on the OpenCV frames just to make sure the morning light hasn't shifted the tracking?
\ufe0f
